With the massive Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale now in full swing, AirPods deals just got even better this week – AirPods Pro 3 are still at one of the best prices to date, but we are also now tracking AirPods Max 2 at $120 off and the lowest price in several months on AirPods 4 with ANC. Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features the return of all-time low pricing on the latest AirTag 2 – singles from $24 (or less) and the 4-pack at $89, a massive $650 price drop on this M5 Pro MacBook Pro for today only, Phone Air back at Black Friday pricing (nearly $160 off, or open-box units up to $350 off), as well as some notable MacBook Neo offers. Check it all out down below.

Summer AirPods deals just dropped even lower, now up to $120 off

After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just dropped even lower. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now sitting at one of the best prices ever at 25% off, but we also saw AirPods 4 with ANC dip to the lowest price in several months and AirPods Max 2 have dropped even lower as of this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $135 (Reg. $179 new) – Best price in 6 months
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Best Buy’s massive 60th Anniversary Sale now live to rival Black Friday! Apple, LG TVs, Android gear, 10x rewards, more

Score Apple’s latest AirTag 2 from just $20 today

Over the weekend we spotted Amazon bringing back some of the best prices ever on Apple’s new 2026 AirTag 2 tracker. It is now offering the 4-pack back at all-time low pricing ($22 per Tag) and, with Best Buy’s 60th Anniversary Sale now in full swing, a single AirTag 2 has now dropped to $24, or just $19.99 in open-box condition. Details below.

As we highlighted over the weekend, Amazon has dropped Apple’s 4-pack of AirTag 2 trackers down to $89 shipped. This is the best new deal at just over $22 per AirTag, but you will also find the single AirTag 2 listing marked down right now if you don’t need four of them.

Regularly $29, Amazon is currently offering singles down at $24.99 and Best Buy has dropped the price a touch lower to $24 even.

  • AirTag 2 $25 (Reg. $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (Reg. $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99)

While we very much expect Amazon to price match here, Best Buy does have a lower price at the time of writing on the single units.

It is also worth pointing out the “excellent” condition open-box offer at Best Buy on the single listing – it is now down at $19.99 for the lowest price we have tracked. Saving the extra $4 over a brand new unit is perhaps not going to be worth it for some, but a deal is a deal and this is the lowest price we can find from a reputable source – this is 31% off the regular new list price.

AirPods Max 2 just hit one of the best prices yet: Now $120 off in 60th Anniversary Sale

Unlocked iPhone Air back at Black Friday pricing (nearly $160 off), open-box up to $350 off

Alongside the AirPods Pro 3 deal at 25% off, now even lower prices on the new AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, return lows on AirTag 2, Best Buy has now launched a massive 60th Anniversary Sale that is bringing back Black Friday pricing on iPhone Air (unlocked brand new).

As part of the now live 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is now offering a particularly notable $159 off all iPhone Air models in brand new, unlocked condition to deliver the best price we can find from a reputable source:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (Reg. $1,400)

We recently featured Best Buy offering nearly $150 off all iPhone Air models as part of the Black Friday in July sale, but they are now even lower – this includes all colors on all three storage configurations.

While Amazon is either undercutting or matching Best Buy on most Apple gear right now as the sale goes live this morning, Best Buy has a lock on iPhone Air – Amazon does not officially carry brand new units.

If you’re looking to land an even lower price on iPhone Air, be sure to check out Best Buy’s “excellent” condition open-box units on this page under the “More options” link for each configuration – we are tracking as much as $350 or more off the new list prices here.

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $798 (Reg. $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $847 (Reg. $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $987 (Reg. $1,199)

Massive $650 price drop hits this M5 Pro MacBook Pro for today only

While this is a more niche, high-end configuration, and you can score far more affordable models with deals on Amazon and the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, we just spotted a brand new condition M5 Pro MacBook Pro at a gigantic $650 off the list price.

B&H is now offering a massive pice drop on Apple’s latest 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $650 off. This is the configuration with 48GB of RAM, a 1TB storage capacity, the 18-Core/20-Core internals, and the Nano-Texture glass upgrade down at $3,099 shipped.

Yes, that is still an expensive MacBook, clearly. But we are also talking about a model that carries a steep $3,749 list price were you to buy it straight from Apple.

If you are in the market for a high-end, ultra-powerful MacBook Pro, this one-day B&H offer is certainly worth consideration if you’re not going to try your hand at refurb unit from Apple and a less powerful machine via Amazon.

There are some more affordable MacBook models worth a look at the official refurb shop right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (Reg. $1,599 new) – $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (Reg. $1,999 new) – $300 off
  • MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (Reg. $1,999 new)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (Reg. $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (Reg. $3,599 new)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,719 (Reg. $3,199 new)

Score a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with your new MacBook Neo today, or get one at $120 off via Apple

The Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale is now full swing with thousands of price drops, 10x rewards bonuses for Plus/Total members, and more. Alongside some solid price drops on AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 landing this week, Best Buy is giving away a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with MacBook Neo purchases (or you can skip that and grab one at $120 off via the Apple refurb store).

As part of its 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is going to buy you a few cups of coffee at Starbucks with your MacBook Neo purchase from $699.

  • Buy a MacBook Neo and get a free $25 Starbucks gift card

It’s certainly not the actual cash discount we hoped for, but considering there has been almost no deals on Apple’s most affordable current-generation MacBook in new condition, we thought you might as well score some FREE Starbucks if you’re looking to grab one right now.

All of that said, if you ask me the best deal on the internet for MacBook Neo is actually coming straight from Apple. The Neo just saw a $100 price hike, but you can side step with the best refurbs you can buy over on the official renewed shop. There’s no free coffee here, but there are models starting at $599 right now and you’ll find as much as $120 off the 512GB model:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

All of these machines ship with:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

Most affordable M4 iPad Air now $100 off, M3 models now $400 off at Best Buy

Alongside the giant Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale and AirPods Pro 3 still down at one of the lowest prices to date, this morning ushered in even lower prices on AirPods Max 2 at $120 offand we are seeing the best deals since the price increase on the most affordable M4 iPad Air models at nearly $100 off. Best Buy also has M3 iPad Air models at $400 off right now as well.

Amazon is now offering nearly $100 off a series of the most affordable M4 iPad Air models. These are the lowest rates we have tracked since the price increase hit retail – you’ll also find some Wi-Fi + Cell variants make down right now as well:

***Note: You will also find select models at $1 less via Best Buy’s 60th Anniversary Sale.

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $650 (Reg. $749)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $749 (Reg. $849)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (Reg. $1,049)

M4 iPad Air 13-inch

  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $850 (Reg. $949)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $950 (Reg. $1,049)

While the Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale is offering much the same deals as Amazon on the latest M4 lineup, you will find as much as $400 off the M3 iPad Air, which will deliver a nearly identical experience for most users.

While you won’t find the most affordable M3 storage configs in stock at Best Buy anymore, it is offering 1TB M3 iPad Air models for $50 less than the price of the 256GB M4 Air right now.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Grab a set of Matte Black Beats Solo Buds down as low as $41 today
  • Score the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable down at the $18 Prime shipped Amazon low (40% off)

  • Tool-free grade 5 titanium Apple Watch bands drops to $70 across natural and black colorways
  • Belkin’s tiny new 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable is down to just $25

AirPods 4 with ANC just hit the best price in 6 months at Amazon, now 25% off

While AirPods Pro 3 are still 25% off the list and currently down at $190 for one of the lowest prices to date, Amazon has also now dropped Apple’s less expensive AirPods Pro 4 with Active Noise Cancellation to the best price we have tracked in roughly 6 months at 25% off.

Amazon is now offering AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation down at $134.99 shipped.

Carrying a regular list price at $179, this is a straight up 25% off price drop and the best deal we can find from a reputable source in brand new condition.

  • AirPods 4 with ANC $135 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

With the base AirPods 4 down at $99 still, deal pricing on Apple’s most affordable current-generation AirPods has been about as reliable as it has been stagnant. The base set has been in the $100 range for months and it has been nearly as long since we have seen the AirPods 4 ANC set for much less than $149…until today.

The AirPods 4 with ANC – the most affordable current-generation AirPods Apple sells with Active Noise Cancellation – are now sitting down at the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon since early March 2026.

While the next-generation AirPods might be one of the only things safe from the storage and memory shortage price hikes next month, it’s hard to say for sure. There is a good chance Apple is ready to upgrade what sounds like the pro set with camera tech and, with the way things have been going lately, everything might see higher MSRPs this go around. Either way, the AirPods Pro ANC are now sitting at one of the best prices of the year.
